description: Rules enforced across the whole platform, whichever app asks. Each section is one rule.

fields.label: Invitations
fields.description: Who an invitation from any app may reach.

fields.label: Invitation Domains
fields.description: An invitation from any app (CRM, Desk, Insights) reaches only an Allowed domain, and never a Blocked one. With no Allowed row, any address that is not Blocked is invited.

fields.label: Data Access for AI Agents (via MCP)
fields.description: The tables staff's AI agents may read rows of, each under the person's own permissions. A table not listed is never read. A listed table brings its child tables; a link to another table shows only its value.

fields.label: Presence
fields.description: When a person in the CRM or Helpdesk counts as idle or away. An idle person's phone and laptop get push alerts again. An away rep gets no new leads.

fields.label: Idle After (Minutes)
fields.description: Push alerts. After this many minutes without a mouse, keyboard or touch, alerts go to the person's phone and laptop again. Between 1 and 120. A blank or 0 uses 5.

fields.label: Auto-Away After (Minutes)
fields.description: Leads. After this many minutes without a mouse, keyboard or touch, a checked-in rep gets no new leads until they touch the screen again. Between 1 and 120. A blank or 0 turns this off.

fields.label: App Documentation
fields.description: Where each app's Docs opens, in its menu on desktop and mobile. An app with no row shows no Docs.

fields.label: Workflow Pace
fields.description: How fast workflows reach patients. Journeys a save starts, scheduled campaign starts and journeys waking from a wait all run in batches at this pace, so a burst never floods the queue and messages stay within the rate the provider accepts. A blank field uses its default.

fields.label: Patients per batch
fields.description: The number of patients started or woken in one batch, between 1 and 500. Progress is saved per patient, so a run that stops loses nothing.

fields.label: Seconds between batches
fields.description: How often a batch starts, between 10 and 3600 seconds. A batch of 60 every 60 seconds is 60 patients a minute.

fields.label: Contact Limit
fields.description: How often workflows may reach one mobile number. WhatsApp sends and voice calls count toward one shared total; email does not. At the limit the send fails and the workflow takes its failed branch. A send the provider refuses gives its slot back.

fields.label: Limit Messages and Calls Per Number
fields.description: When on, every WhatsApp message or call a workflow sends to a mobile number is counted, and stops at the limit. When off, nothing is counted.

fields.label: Messages Allowed
fields.description: WhatsApp messages and calls together, from 1 to 20.

fields.label: In The Last
fields.description: A rolling period counted back from now.

fields.label: Period
fields.description: A week counts as 7 days, a month as 30.

fields.label: AI Agents (via MCP)
fields.description: Call limits and answer sizes for the server staff connect their AI agents to. It starts only when the MCP::Docs::server feature flag is on. A blank field uses its default; on Calls Per Person and Calls For Everyone, 0 removes the limit.

fields.label: Window (Seconds)
fields.description: Both call limits count calls over this many seconds. A refused caller is told to retry after this long.

fields.label: Calls Per Person
fields.description: Most calls one person's agent may make in each window. Set 0 to remove this limit for each person.

fields.label: Calls For Everyone
fields.description: Most calls all agents together may make in each window. Set 0 to remove the limit for the whole site.

fields.label: Query Time Limit (Seconds)
fields.description: A database read slower than this is stopped and the agent is told to narrow it. A blank or 0 uses the default.

fields.label: Handbook Results
fields.description: Most handbook pages one search returns. A blank or 0 uses the default.

fields.label: Schema Results
fields.description: Most doctypes, and most fields, that one schema search returns. A blank or 0 uses the default.

fields.label: Characters Per Page
fields.description: Most characters of a long handbook page sent at once. The agent asks for the next page by number.

fields.label: Rows Per Page
fields.description: Most rows one table search returns. The agent is told to narrow its search rather than page on. A blank or 0 uses the default.
